title: Board debate on launching an AI clinic intake assistant
scenario:
TOPIC: Decide whether to launch an AI clinic intake assistant in 45 days
The proposal is a public launch to 200 Indian clinics in 45 days at ₹12,000 per month. The product collects symptoms and contact details over WhatsApp, suggests urgency, and writes to clinic calendars. The solo founder has ₹5 lakh, a prototype, no paid pilots, no WhatsApp approval, and no healthcare legal review. Conduct the full board debate: the CEO proposal, domain-scoped objections from every specialist, evidence check, steelmanned counterarguments, visible revision tied to objections, an unambiguous final decision, remaining risks with accountable parties, sequenced execution, a single owner, a deadline, and a concrete reversal trigger.

bad_signs.name: alignment without substance
bad_signs.pattern: the team is aligned|strategy is sound|approved with minor tweaks

bad_signs.name: discussion instead of decision
bad_signs.pattern: further discussion needed|continue research and revisit soon

improvement_suggestions: Preserve each specialist's strongest challenge instead of averaging them.
Show exactly how the proposal changed after scrutiny.
Assign unresolved unknowns to accountable people with dates.
